extraction.Name: Peter St John
extraction.Buyer: Harry Grey made a loan to Peter St John before the patent was received and as soon as it was received he got a loan on the land and using this money he paid St John the balance for the land; at this time a man by the name of Jerome Summy has the land and assumed the $1800.00 mtg on the tract of land
extraction.NOTES: File reference 5-1142; dated January 14, 1928; Harry Grey made a loan to Peter St John before patent was received; loan was a State loan of $1800.00; Jerome Summy assumed the $1800.00 mortgage; Harry Grey reportedly in prison for issuing bad checks at time of writing; records show land was selling for twice as much as the Indian received for his allotment at the time of sale | TASK 5 CAT_3 BACKFILL 2026-05-04 (patents database): Allotment 546 sourced from federal-register-app patents database (Christian's research, 2026-05-04).
